tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Orientation Covering Theorem] 1. chB:B.18If $M$ is a connected, nonorientable smooth manifold, then there exist an oriented smooth manifold $\tilde{M}$ and a two-sheeted smooth covering map $\tilde{\pi }: \tilde{M} \to M$, called the orientation covering of $M$.
